lines.text: Paul reminds the Galatians that Jesus Christ was portrayed as crucified, and asks if they received the Spirit by works of the law or by hearing with faith.
Paul asks if, after starting in the Spirit, they are now finishing in the flesh, and says God works miracles among them.
Abraham believed God and it was credited to him as righteousness, so those who have faith are sons of Abraham.
The Scripture foretold to Abraham that all tribes will be blessed through him, and all who rely on works of the law are under a curse.
Moses redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us, so that by faith we might receive the Spirit.
